summary: The timed loop invokes local CSR SpMV on every requested iteration. The local row-offset array bounds each row and spans its values/columns; emitted timed host code inlines indexed accesses, arithmetic, stores and all traversal/repetition backedges.

source_evidence.claim: Rank-local row offsets are constructed with their columns/values; spmvCpu visits each row's entire offset interval and stores its result. Parsed -i controls repeated timed calls; MPI_Gatherv uses row ownership counts.

compiled_evidence.claim: The actual timed runBenchmark path records MPI_Wtime and inlines the CSR row/nonzero traversal inside an outer iteration counter; indexed loads, multiply/add and row stores occur in the body, with nested nonzero/row backedges and outer counter increment/compare/backedge before ending MPI_Wtime.
